source_input_rules: Use only the per-trait source-resolved original raw identity; do not substitute a current release or alter original INFO, frequency, N, permissions or phenotype decisions.

Before and after any replay, bind full compressed raw bytes/SHA, selected source and immutable panel/schema/code/reference/binary/library identities. This review did not perform those GWAS-body reads.

Reuse LDL/HDL/triglycerides prefilter outputs with the exact original-hash native receipts and provenance; freshly verify reused inputs at admitted execution, preserving their paths and original files.
full_stream_comparison_rules: Read baseline and replay gzip streams to full EOF with bounded buffers, validating gzip CRC/trailers, counting bytes/newlines and reporting any trailing incomplete line; compute complete decompressed SHA-256.

Require exact ordered decompressed harmonized content, literal headers, columns, alleles, coordinates, numeric serialization and missing-value tokens; no approximate scientific PASS or row sorting is authorized.

Require exact ordered decompressed munged content, the original 1,217,311-row HapMap3 skeleton, source-order allele fields and matching original nonmissing/missing N/Z patterns; preserve stock three-decimal serialization.

Require archived harmonization rows_in/rows_out and every ordered drop count to reconcile exactly; compare scientifically meaningful QC metadata and source/reference hashes. New absolute output/input paths and additional provenance fields are reported as qualified metadata changes, not forced to equal historical paths.

Require original prefilter source_rows, retained_rows, raw/allowlist identities and deterministic compressed SHA. Compare all historical stock munging removal counts, N cutoff and nonmissing output count; retain warnings.

Report complete compressed SHA independently. A different gzip SHA alone is not a scientific mismatch; establish exact decompressed content before classifying serialization differences. Compare header, deflate and trailer bytes separately before making any causal statement about why compressed bytes differ.

If exact decompressed content or scientific counts differ, preserve both artifacts and a bounded typed row/field diagnostic on the SSD, mark FAIL/UNRESOLVED, and do not relax thresholds or invent a tolerance after seeing results.
original_method_rules: Apply original source-column alias priority and preferred BETA over OR; OR inputs use log(OR). Preserve source effect allele/sign; reverse point liftover complements alleles but does not by itself negate BETA.
Preserve one-based UCSC point mapping and all ambiguity/nonautosomal/unmapped losses, exact pinned coordinate/rsID-allele map behavior and source-order identity decisions.

Preserve the original sequential QC order, INFO >0.6 behavior with missingness qualification, original floating-point MAF expression, inclusive chr6:25,000,000-34,000,000 exclusion and first surviving pre-N duplicate rule.

Preserve sample-size branch priority, explicit 2*Effective_N or 2*NEFFDIV2 conversions, per-SNP/global or configured N reference and 50% reference cutoff. Never rescue a later duplicate when the first surviving pre-N occurrence fails the final N gate.
Use unchanged pinned stock munge_sumstats.py, --merge-alleles and --chunksize 500000. Ignore FRQ only for the seven archived absence-proved traits; fabricate neither FRQ nor INFO.

Stock munge derives signed Z from sqrt(chi2.isf(P,1)) and effect direction, not BETA/SE. Preserve the post-merge-family global N 90th-percentile divided by 1.5 rule, median-sign check, full HapMap3 left join and three-decimal output.
proposed_bounded_streaming_alternative: Prepare a separately versioned result-free implementation and freeze its method/resource plan before actual replay. Do not modify original scripts or claim this is the original full-DataFrame implementation.

Use small source chunks and new SSD spools/indexes. Determine global parser/coercion and column-presence/branch decisions; preserve pandas missingness, numeric parsing and serialization semantics rather than silently forcing different dtypes.

Pass one applies the exact ordered pre-N scientific filters, mapping/liftover and first-occurrence deduplication; store only the required surviving fields on the SSD and compute global N-mode/max information. Use a disk-backed exact membership index to avoid a multi-million-entry Python seen set.

Pass two applies the frozen global N decision/cutoff and emits the exact harmonized column schema in source order. Do not add an unregistered HapMap3 prefilter to traits whose historical harmonized output retained genome-wide variants.

Keep stock munging for final processing. Its original 500,000-row chunks and approximately 1.2-million-variant retained family still require real aggregate RSS supervision; chunked input is not a memory-quota guarantee.

Before admitting a real stream, independently test duplicates across chunk boundaries and a first low-N duplicate; global maxima/N quantiles; all-NA or invalid N branches; INFO/FRQ absence versus present missingness; P zero/invalid; OR versus BETA priority; reverse mapping; map ambiguity; literal MAF endpoints and numeric parser/dtype boundaries. Synthetic controls establish implementation behavior only.

If historical runtime/parser behavior cannot be reproduced exactly, record an explicit implementation/runtime qualification, retain exact full-content failures, and block claims of exact raw-to-harmonized reproduction until independently adjudicated.
operational_requirements_before_executio: Hold the existing shared heavy-worker lock for all supervised heavy stages; one worker and one BLAS thread, no second estimator/process family.
Freeze a new private core_pipeline namespace and refuse any prior output, failed receipt or attempt rather than relying on original helpers' overwrite-capable behavior.
Bind the actual harmonization executable and pandas/numpy versions. Declared workflow pins are Python3.11.11/pandas2.2.3/numpy1.26.4; recovered LDSC3.9/pandas1.3.3/numpy1.21.5 is a distinct runtime.

Freeze resource footprints for final gzip plus uncompressed spools/indexes/temporary files, internal/SSD floors, deadlines, aggregate owned-group RSS, immutable failure journaling, catchable-signal deferral, verified group teardown and post-hash terminal gates.
Original historical harmonized+ munged gzip files total 5,178,384,793 bytes; that is only a compressed final-output baseline, not a complete new SSD footprint reservation.

Original shell02 still hardcodes data/raw; use the proposed explicit absolute-input/NEW-output command templates and preserve equivalent scientific argv. Do not invoke the original shell into the historical tree or silently redirect its locked panel.
remaining_source_blocker: The original prostate source container remains unresolved (42/43 exact containers). Its exact original materialized raw is available, allowing a separately admitted raw-stage replay; this cannot establish complete original-container-to-raw reproduction.
scientific_claim_limits: No GWAS body was read or decompressed, no replay or estimator was launched, and no raw-to-result or scientific validity claim is made by this design.
